explain.families_talking: The elders of both families have spoken or met.
explain.engaged: Both families have agreed (baat pakki or mangni).
explain.nikah_done: The nikah has taken place. Both profiles will be closed.

stage.title: Stage
stage.you_suggested: You suggested: {{stage}}. Waiting for {{name}} to confirm.
stage.cooldown: You can suggest this again on {{date}}.
stage.share_hint: Families usually exchange contact details at this point.
stage.engaged_text: Would you like to pause your profile so you stop receiving new interests?
stage.nikah_title: Mubarak! May Allah bless this marriage.
stage.nikah_text: Both profiles are now closed and your other connections have ended. You can still read this conversation.

connected.me: You accepted the interest. You can now chat.
connected.them: Your interest was accepted. You can now chat.

contact_share_revoked.me: You stopped sharing your contact details.

stage_declined.me: You did not confirm the suggestion.

notice.money: Be careful. Never send money or share bank details with someone you met here, whatever the reason. If this member asks for money, report them.
notice.off_platform: No need to rush to another app. Here you can block and report; elsewhere you cannot. Move when you and your family are comfortable.
notice.contact_info: This message seems to contain contact details. Share yours only when you and your family are ready.

tips.title: Before you start
tips.respect: Be respectful. This is a family platform.
tips.money: Never send money, whatever the reason.
tips.phone: Share your phone number only when you and your family are comfortable.
tips.report: You can block or report from the menu at any time.

chats.title: Chats
chats.preview_new: You are now connected. Say salaam.
chats.preview_update: Open to see the latest update
chats.quiet: No messages for a week. Say salaam, or end the conversation respectfully.
chats.select: Choose a conversation to read it here.

active.title: No conversations yet.
active.text: When an interest is accepted you can chat here.

archived.title: Archived chats appear here.
archived.text: A new message brings a chat back.

ended.title: Connections that have ended appear here.

chat.chip_family: Thank you for accepting. May I know more about your family?

message.remove_title: Remove this message for both of you?
message.remove_too_late: Messages can be removed only within 15 minutes.

composer.label: Message
composer.hint: Press Enter to send, Shift and Enter for a new line.
composer.limit_banner: You have reached today's message limit. It resets at midnight, Pakistan time.

disabled.ended: This conversation has ended. You can still read the messages.
disabled.closed: Your profile is closed. Reopen it to send messages.

my_contact.title: Your contact details
my_contact.none: You have not shared your contact details with {{name}}.
my_contact.stop_title: Stop sharing your contact details with {{name}}?

their_contact.title: Their contact details
their_contact.none: {{name}} has not shared contact details with you.
their_contact.private: Shared with you privately. Please do not pass these details on.

share.title: Share contact details with {{name}}
share.guardian_hint: Many families prefer that first contact goes through a parent or guardian.
share.warning: Once shared, the other person may have saved your details. Stopping the share hides them in the app but cannot take them back.

end.title: End this connection?

reason.not_compatible: We are not a good match

end.text: The chat becomes read-only for both of you, and any shared contact details and photo access are withdrawn. {{name}} is not told the reason. A new interest is possible after 90 days.
